jobs.occupation: Lawgent: Founding Editor & Partnerships Lead, Law Magazine
jobs.description:
Lawgent is launching Law Magazine, a publication about the people, ideas and technology shaping the legal world. We are looking for a founding editor who can both tell strong stories and build the partnerships that make the magazine grow.
What you will do
Build Law Magazine from the ground up: set the editorial direction, the format and the publishing rhythm.

Write features, interviews and profiles of lawyers, law firms, legal tech founders and industry leaders.

Shoot your own photography: portraits, events and editorial images. A strong visual eye is central to this role.

Partnerships (core part of the role): find and secure sponsors, advertisers and partners such as law firms, legal tech companies, universities and associations.

Grow the readership through social media, newsletters and the network you build.

Who you are
A journalist, writer or editor with a published portfolio.

Passionate about photography, with images that show it.

Comfortable approaching decision-makers and turning a conversation into a partnership.

Self-driven and entrepreneurial; you want to build something, not just fill a position.

Interest in law, business or technology is a strong plus. A legal background is not required.

Excellent written English. Additional languages are a plus.

Compensation
This is a performance-based role. Your compensation comes from the partnerships and sponsorship revenue you bring in, plus the opportunity to grow into a long-term leading role as the magazine scales.
What we offer
Full creative ownership of a new publication from day one.

Direct access to Lawgent's network across the legal sector.

Flexible, fully remote work.

A front-row seat in a fast-growing legal tech group.

Facilitate security risk assessments and contribute expertise in threats, controls and technical impact. 
Interpret security policies and frameworks, helping stakeholders apply them to specific solutions.

If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?
We are now looking for a Senior Game Designer
Join the Helldivers 2 team and expand our mission toolbox with more systemic variables, more dynamic objectives and more room for emergent shenanigans.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll come up with ideas for missions and game modes, then build, script, balance and debug them yourself in the engine.
What you'll do:
From Ideation to Game: Create missions. You’ll draft the core loop, flow and win/fail conditions, then script the working prototype yourself

Design for Modular Worlds: Create mission structures and objectives that work with our semi-procedural map generation

Design for Sandbox Emergence: Create mechanics that cut across mission objectives to spark unexpected encounters

Engine Scripting: Script objective flows, encounters, interactable objects and success/fail states in our in-house engine

Stress-Test & Debug: Test and debug your own setups, chasing down edge cases, logic breaks and performance issues so your missions hold up in live multiplayer

Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Work closely with Level Design, Tech Design, Code, UI, Art and Audio

Iterate with Live Data: Use telemetry, completion rates and player feedback to balance and improve missions after release

Mentor & Lead: Share best practices in encounter flow, system design, and design documentation with other designers.

Who you are:
You’re as passionate about co-op shooters as we are. You’re friendly and helpful, but also efficient, hard-working and dedicated to the game design craft. You also…

Have about 5+ years of game design experience in AA/AAA, with at least one shipped title where you personally implemented missions, encounters or systems

Are comfortable scripting in the engine (Lua, Python, C# or similar). You can build mission logic and state machines without relying on engineers for the basics

Are a Systems Thinker who understands player psychology, systemic design, pacing and core loops

Have Autonomy & Problem-Solving skills that take a high-level pitch like “a multi-stage sabotage operation against an Automaton strongpoint”, break it down, greybox it and see it through to release

Are able to write Clear design docs and explain your decisions to other disciplines

Have Strong Co-op Sensibilities, to know what makes shared victory feel earned and team failure feel hilarious rather than cheap

Are a Master of Emergent Sandbox Chaos, to balance objectives around unpredictable systems like roaming AI, physics and destructible environments

Have Great English skills, both written and spoken

Admission to third-cycle (doctoral) education is regulated in MDU’s admission regulations, which compile national and local rules for eligibility and admission to doctoral studies at Mälardalen University. https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/education/third-cycle-studies
 
The doctoral position includes full-time employment as a doctoral student for the duration of the education, which corresponds to four years.
Position description
The doctoral student will work in the PyroMet project, where we develop a computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-based digital twin of an industrial slag fuming furnace together with Boliden, Linde and Luleå University of Technology. The research focuses on understanding and modelling reactive multiphase flows at high temperature, where gas and slag interact through chemical reactions. The student will develop physics-based models of the fluid flow, heat transfer and reactions in such systems, and will use machine learning to build fast simulation methods that keep the accuracy of high-fidelity CFD. The aim is to support both the experimental and numerical activities of the project, further develop the existing numerical modelling framework for submerged injection, and optimise the relevant system components to improve the efficiency and performance of the slag-fuming process.
 
The work combines theoretical and experimental fluid dynamics with modern computational tools, Optimisation methods and also data-driven methods. Part of it will be done together with the industrial and academic partners.
 
The doctoral student is responsible for his own doctoral education, following the individual study plan. This includes planning and carrying out research together with supervisors and colleagues, publishing the results in peer-reviewed journals, and completing 60 credits of courses.
